# SmartThings Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that works with Samsung SmartThings through its REST API: device lists and states, sending commands, running scenes and routines, and reading locations and rooms. It acts on your physical home — locks, garage doors, alarms, sirens — so the skill confirms with the user before any write that changes the home's state; locks and alarm changes are confirmed every time. The SmartThings API itself is free to use with a personal access token. Uses your SmartThings personal access token, kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from SmartThings's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. No secrets in the repo.
